document.title: Schedule K-1 (568), Member's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc. (California) - five columns, (b) California adjustments
document.issued_by: California limited liability company (Franchise Tax Board form)
document.notes: The California counterpart of Schedule K-1 (Form 1065), usually printed with the federal form in the same packet. **Its column (b) is the CALIFORNIA ADJUSTMENT, not a federal figure** - it is the difference California makes to the federal amount, so reading column (b) onto a federal line reports an adjustment as income. Column (a) restates the federal amount and column (c) is the California total; none of the three is a federal figure this map may place. The federal consequence arrives on k-1-1065, which the taxpayer also receives. Declared so the page can be NAMED rather than falling to `unknown` - which is what happened to CA-593 three times before it was declared, and to these forms in both packets spec 075 was measured against (4 pages and ~16 pages, in no vocabulary at all).

extraction.note: Out of this map's jurisdiction (US-CA). Classifiable so it can be named and held; deliberately not extracted federally. E19 refuses a federal route out of it, and W20 counts it as named-and-nothing-else, which is correct here rather than a gap.
